feature: Deck stats, PRs 1-3: the switch, the placement shell, the curve card and the Jobs card
note: Needs DECK_STATS_ENABLED=true on the server and STATS_DECK (a deck with at least one creature and one other non-land card, so pressing Creature shows both lit and dimmed squares). The list toolbar shows the Stats segment beside All and Shopping; the stats row presses it and shows the six Stats cards with the list tools hidden. The curve and Jobs cards draw data (Jobs needs the deck's cards labeled and a Ramp row above zero); the other four figures stay empty shells until their PRs.
